entities.name: Shaka Zulu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shaka kaSenzangakhona, also known as Shaka (the) Zulu and Sigidi kaSenzangakhona, was the king of the Zulu Kingdom from 1816 to 1828. One of the most influential monarchs of the Zulu, he ordered wide-reaching reforms that reorganized the military into a formidable force.

entities.name: Shaka Zulu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zulu king and military innovator (c. 1787–1828) who transformed a small chiefdom into the most powerful state in southeastern Africa. He revolutionized African warfare with the iklwa (short stabbing spear), the bull-horn formation, and total mobilization — tactics that triggered the Mfecane, a period of widespread chaos and migration across southern Africa.
